grace = 15 max = 12 min = 6 gear = 1 function onTick() if grace > 0 then grace = grace - 1 end
rps = input.getNumber(1) manual = input.getBool(1) gearUp = input.getBool(2) gearDown = input.getBool(3)

output.setNumber(1, gear) end
